text:
maya: Heads-up team — we're scheduling qx6b-lite onboarding later today. Need a sanitized candidate pool + golden refresh before we run int4/int8 comparisons. target ~100k candidates, golden 2k, quickcheck 3k. can we do a short ingestion freeze to avoid label drift?

diego: timeline? i can coordinate dedupe and pin images. also want to avoid tokenizer v4 mismatch; some samples tokenized 2x earlier.

priya: propose plan:
- 16:10 UTC: embed-cluster prune (faiss hnsw, cosine th 0.87)
- 16:35 UTC: fuzzyhash sweep (th=0.82)
- 17:00 UTC: export quickcheck 3k stratified by lang/intent/len
- 17:30 UTC: run int4 vs int8 on 2k golden holdout
if we see >2% precision drop we fallback to int8.

ops-bot: will pause label ingestion for channel "curation" between 16:00-18:00 UTC. Requeue rule: batches with >20% incomplete get soft-requeued.

dedupe-bot: scheduling pipeline:
```
pipeline: embed-cluster->fuzzyhash
embed_index: faiss-hnsw32
cosine_threshold: 0.87
fuzzy_threshold: 0.82
shards: 160
quickcheck_sample: 3000
```
Starting at 16:10 UTC. Outputs -> s3://rwd-curation/qx6b-lite/dedupe/2026-03-22/

label-bot: label ingestion paused at 16:00 UTC. React with :white_check_mark: to resume.

diego: i'll pin runtime image to rwd-infer:2026-03-20-qx6b and lock CUDA=12.1 for the run. disabling autoscale for determinism. Also enabling KV-cache warmup.

maya: for dedupe order, prefer embed-first to catch semantic paraphrases. fuzzyhash will catch near-duplicates. priya please ensure we keep 25% long-context (>1024) in the quickcheck.

priya: yes — quickcheck stratification: 25% longctx, 20% non-en, 15% code, rest diverse intents. i'll take manual spotcheck of the 3k quickcheck after dedupe.

maya: eval-bot — can you prepare a minimal harness: token-delta, BLEU/ROUGE, QA-precision for QA prompts, hallucination detector. abort gates: >2% precision drop OR >2.5% hallucination increase. we also need token-level cost delta and p95 latency.

eval-bot: harness queued. outputs: per-sample CSV + top-40 regression list + aggregate metrics. will publish after runs.

diego: perf estimate: ~26M tokens -> est compute $400 (int4), qint8 fallback est $540. p95 est ~330ms.

ops-bot: small ops note — requeue any annotator batches with >12h idle before 15:50. we'll soft-drain.

priya: one more: run tokenizer-v4 consistency check before dedupe; drop samples that tokenized >1.5x length relative to tokenizer v3. i saw some artifacts from HTML noise.

maya: good catch. diego can you run tokenizer-check script and post counts?

diego: running tokenizer-check now; will attach counts to s3 and post summary before 16:05.

label-bot: reminder: paused. resume requires :white_check_mark:.

priya: i'll start spotcheck after dedupe and post a short summary: top variance buckets, any high-duplicate residuals, and a few example failures.

maya: keep the thread minimal during the run — only blockers/regressions. if eval-bot flags >threshold, we fallback automatically and abort promotion.

diego: canary route configured: primary=int4, fallback=int8, monitor=eval-bot, alert p95>380ms or quality gate fail.

eval-bot: starting quickcheck smoke at ~17:10 UTC once dedupe output is ready. expect CSV + top diffs in ~20-30m.
